scope: 22 pending media records; source access and actual-pixel inspection distinguished from acceptance

decisions.evidence: 16 November2026: Actual downloaded pixels contact-inspected; no promotion based on catalogue appearance alone. Original-source direct requests and current outcomes recorded. Manufacturer/dealer catalogue identity does not establish actual-photograph provenance; existing source/variant limits remain in force.

Reject this association with case reference 126505: the original 2024 Rolex newsroom page describes two white-gold, diamond-bezel mother-of-pearl Daytona variants. It credits its loose 4131 image to Rolex/Ulysse Frechelin but does not document that photographed execution in Everose 126505. Shared calibre number alone cannot establish exact-case execution equivalence. Original page re-read through web connector on 16 November; current direct image request returned403, so no new pixel inspection is claimed. Earlier recorded pixel review remains preserved. Rejection concerns this stored reference association, not the value of the manufacturer image for properly sourced references.
